candidates.reason: This is a near-straight shrink of the original. The logo text sits correctly in the navy circle, but at 50 px tall the two-line 'Lima & Co Group' is small and nearly touches the circle's top and bottom. The pattern panels are compressed into the left two-thirds, so the halftone detail turns to mush.

Same structure as candidate 1, and the text has slightly more breathing room inside the navy circle. The wordmark is still small for a 320x50 banner. The patterns are crushed into noisy slivers, and the left panels end in awkward cut-off arcs. It works, but it's an unpolished scale-down.

'Lima & Co Group' sits directly on the busy white and gold halftone circle instead of the navy field. The white text vanishes against the white pattern and is mostly illegible. The navy area on the right is left empty, so the brand name is effectively lost.

The wordmark is the largest and most readable of the set, but it fills almost the whole 50 px height, leaving almost no margin above 'Lima' or below 'Group'. The pattern strip is cramped like the others. Overall it reads as a shrink, not a rearranged layout.
